sql.query: SELECT id FROM tbl_users WHERE id=:userId AND isActive=1 AND isPlatformAdmin=1 LIMIT 1

SELECT id,tenantType,lifecycleStatus,accessEndDate FROM tbl_tenants WHERE id=:tenantId AND :tenantType IN ('live','demo','trial') AND :lifecycleStatus IN ('active','expired','read_only','suspended','closed') AND NULLIF(TRIM(:reason),'') IS NOT NULL AND (:scenarioPackId=0 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_scenario_packs p WHERE p.id=:scenarioPackId2 AND p.status='published')) LIMIT 1

options.message: The tenant lifecycle request is invalid.

sql.query: UPDATE tbl_tenants SET tenantType=:tenantType,lifecycleStatus=:lifecycleStatus,accessStartDate=NULLIF(:accessStart,''),accessEndDate=NULLIF(:accessEnd,''),retentionEndDate=NULLIF(:retentionEnd,''),cleanupEligibleDate=NULLIF(:cleanupDate,''),convertedToLiveDate=CASE WHEN tenantType='trial' AND :newType='live' THEN COALESCE(convertedToLiveDate,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE convertedToLiveDate END,lifecycleModifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=:tenantId

INSERT INTO tbl_tenant_lifecycle_history (tenantId,previousTenantType,newTenantType,previousLifecycleStatus,newLifecycleStatus,previousAccessEndDate,newAccessEndDate,actionCode,reason,changedByUserId) VALUES (:tenantId,:oldType,:newType,:oldStatus,:newStatus,:oldEnd,NULLIF(:newEnd,''),CASE WHEN :oldType2='trial' AND :newType2='live' THEN 'CONVERTED_TO_LIVE' WHEN :newStatus2='expired' THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN :newStatus3='read_only' THEN 'READ_ONLY' WHEN :newStatus4='suspended' THEN 'SUSPENDED' WHEN :newStatus5='active' AND :oldStatus2<>'active' THEN 'REACTIVATED' WHEN COALESCE(:oldEnd2,'')<>COALESCE(:newEnd2,'') THEN 'EXPIRY_CHANGED' ELSE 'LIFECYCLE_UPDATED' END,:reason,:userId)

INSERT INTO tbl_scenario_instances (tenantId,scenarioPackId,currentStepId,status,guideMode,simulatedDateTime) SELECT :tenantId,p.id,(SELECT s.id FROM tbl_scenario_steps s WHERE s.scenarioPackId=p.id AND s.isActive=1 ORDER BY s.sequenceNumber LIMIT 1),'ready','guided',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tbl_scenario_packs p WHERE p.id=:scenarioPackId AND p.status='published' AND :tenantType='demo' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_scenario_instances i WHERE i.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND i.scenarioPackId=p.id)
